hits.about: Blue Wave Tower is a contemporary project by developer Tiger Properties, located in the Dubailand neighbourhood of Dubai. This multi-storey residential complex comprises 24 floors, offering a variety of housing options ranging from cosy studios to spacious 1 & 2 bedroom apartments. The interior of the residential complex is designed using high quality materials and modern technology to provide maximum comfort and convenience for residents.The architectural design of the Blue Wave Tower building is made by Engineer Adnan Saffarini and has a modern and stylish appearance. Tiger International General Contracting was the general contractor for the construction, which guarantees the quality and reliability of the project.The complex also offers an extensive range of modern amenities and entertainment. The grounds include a swimming pool and fitness room, recreational and picnic areas, a playground for younger residents, as well as green spaces and walking pathsDue to its convenient location in Dubailand, residents of Blue Wave Tower have easy access to the city's major shopping centres, restaurants, entertainment venues and other amenities. Img Worlds Of Adventure is just 5 minutes away, while Silicon Oasis, Dubai Outlet Mall, Dubai Mall and the famous Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden are all within a 10-15 minute radius.Blue Wave Tower is a superb residential development that combines contemporary design, quality materials and high levels of service, creating the perfect place for comfortable and stylish living in the heart of Dubai.
hits.title: Blue Wave Tower
